observations.observation:
**Header:** Bold "Operations overview" with smaller gray subtitle "Local snapshot — every control on this screen stays in-document"; a light-green pill "● All systems nominal" sits top-right. Text is sharp and unclipped.

**Cards:** Three equal-width white cards with light borders, rounded corners, and even horizontal spacing. Hierarchy is compact: small uppercase gray labels (THROUGHPUT · REQ/MIN, ERROR RATE, CLUSTER CAPACITY), large dark values (1,284; 0.42%; 68%), then small green deltas with ▲/▼ triangles ("4.2% vs last hour", "0.08 pts — improving").

**Meter:** Capacity card shows "Capacity used" above a rounded bar — dark green fill to roughly two-thirds on a light gray track, consistent with 68%.

**Spacing:** Padding is consistent; no clipping observed. Inference: content fills only the top ~40% of the viewport, leaving a large empty gray region below.

**Visible observations (960×585 viewport, image cropped from 705px source height):**

- Header, three aligned KPI cards, and bottom row are present with consistent gutters; KPI values, progress bar, and "All systems nominal" badge render cleanly.
- One-screen fit cannot be confirmed: the bottom row is clipped at the image edge. The Ops Assistant prompt input ("Ask about incidents, deploys…") and the lower portions of all three cards are cut off — likely vertical overflow, though cropping is a provenance fact, not proof of overflow.
- Topology canvas shows nodes Intake, Validate, Dispatch, Archive with an "ingest" edge label; a second label near center appears mirrored/upside-down and illegible. The third edge/label is not visibly confirmed.
- Zoom controls sit close beneath the Intake node but don't appear to overlap.
- Recent Activity timestamps align right; text wraps without clipping.

Observed at the captured area (909×569, cropped from a 909×595 source; 960×585 viewport): header, KPI row of three equal-height cards aligned on one baseline, progress bar intact. Prompt input with send button is fully visible; activity list shows three items with timestamps.

Inference/limitations: because the capture excludes ~26 px at bottom and ~51 px at right of the viewport, the lower panels' bottom edges and the assistant panel's right edge fall outside the image — no vertical clipping beyond that point can be confirmed. In the topology, labels Validate, Dispatch, Archive are readable and thin edges visible, but a fourth node's label is obscured by the overlapping zoom-control panel.

**Observed directly:** Within the captured crop (909×569 of the 960×585 viewport), the header, three metric cards (Throughput, Error Rate, Cluster Capacity), Recent Activity list, Ingest Topology, and Ops Assistant panels all render without internal overlap. Flow node labels — Intake, Validate, Dispatch, Archive — are fully readable, with the "Svelte Flow" caption visible. The prompt input ("Ask about incidents, deploys, capacity…") and circular send button appear complete, with space beneath them.

**Inference/limitation:** The image is cropped — roughly 51px of width and ~16–22px of height are not shown. All three lower panels extend to the image's bottom edge with no visible bottom borders or corner rounding, so their true bottoms — and whether anything is clipped below — cannot be confirmed from this capture alone. One-screen fit is therefore only partially verifiable.

No — this cannot be confirmed. Direct observation: the three bottom panels (Recent Activity, Ingest Topology, Ops Assistant) run all the way to the bottom edge of the image and are visibly cut off; none of their bottom edges or bottom rounded corners are rendered. The image itself is cropped (569px of a 583px source height captured), so additional content below the visible boundary may exist but is not observable. The KPI cards, header, and badge are fully visible with intact rounded corners, and the panels' side edges are clean, but the question of vertical fit within the 585px viewport remains unverified — the dashboard either extends beyond the viewport or the crop obscures it. Inference only: it likely overflows, but the render cannot prove either case.

observations.observation:
**Visible observations:**

- Header: bold dark "Operations overview" with gray "Live snapshot · updated 09:42" beside it, roughly baseline-aligned; a light-green "All systems nominal" chip with dot sits right-aligned. Hierarchy reads clearly.
- Three equal-width white cards on a pale background, evenly gapped and left-aligned with the title; consistent rounded corners.
- Cards 1–2 show uppercase gray label, large dark value (48.2k, 0.42%), and a small green delta row with triangle icon; contrast is adequate throughout.
- Card 3 shows only the "P95 LATENCY" label — its value/delta area is visibly empty at matching card height. This is directly observed; whether content is missing or clipped cannot be confirmed.
- No horizontal clipping or overflow within the visible region; everything below the cards is empty background.

**Directly visible:** Header with title, timestamp, and "All systems nominal" pill; three KPI cards render completely with legible values, labels, and colored deltas — hierarchy is clear. The Ops assistant card dominates vertically, with a large empty gap below its title before the user bubble ("Summarize overnight incidents.") and two reply paragraphs; the prompt field with purple send button sits inside. Spacing there reads loose, not compact.

**Clipping:** The bottom row is cut mid-content — only "09:24 … Deploy api-gateway v2.14.1" and the "Pipeline topology" title show; no nodes or labeled edges are visible.

**Limitation/inference:** The capture is cropped, so full-page fit can't be confirmed, but the dashboard clearly exceeds the 585px viewport, pushing the activity list and topology below the fold.

**Section order (observed):** header ("Operations overview" with status badge), then three KPI cards (Requests, Error rate, P95 latency), then a row pairing Recent activity with Pipeline topology, then the Ops assistant conversation — matches the expected sequence.

**Screen fit:** the image is cropped; the bottom edge cuts through the Ops assistant card, so whether the dashboard ends within the viewport cannot be confirmed. The capture's taller source height suggests content may extend below, but that is inference.

**Conversation spacing:** messages sit at consistent intervals; no oversized blank gap appears between the user bubble and replies. The gap between the "Ops assistant" heading and first message is larger. Notably, the "Recent activity" title renders below its list rows.

**Observed:** Header "Operations overview" with "Live snapshot · updated 09:42" and green "All systems nominal" pill; three aligned KPI cards (48.2k, 0.42%, 142 ms). Left column: "Recent activity" title sits above its four timestamped rows; below, "Pipeline topology" shows Ingest, Validate, Enrich, Store nodes on a dotted canvas with visible edges (one labeled "archive") plus a small circle node; "Svelte Flow" credit visible. Right: "Ops assistant" chat with user bubble, two reply paragraphs, and an input with blue send button. Text is legible, spacing even; nodes, edges, and text show no clipping; no empty containers. **Limitation:** a thin blue strip crosses the very bottom, and the Ops assistant card's bottom border isn't visible, so its lower edge can't be directly confirmed.
